name: PurePen AI – AI Content Generator with Claude, GPT-4o, Gemini & More
author: solverwp

sections.description:
PurePen AI is a free AI content generator plugin for WordPress that lets you create publication-ready blog posts, page content, and SEO metadata without leaving the editor. Choose from 8 leading AI providers, enter a topic, and get a complete article — titles, full HTML body, tags, and meta excerpt — in seconds.

Whether you are a blogger, content marketer, or agency managing dozens of sites, PurePen AI saves hours of writing time while keeping you in full control of the output.

Why PurePen AI?

  • Start for free — no API key needed. Five free generations are included on activation so you can try every feature immediately.
  • Guided API key setup. When you are ready for unlimited use, a built-in step-by-step wizard walks you through getting a free API key from Groq or OpenRouter in under 2 minutes — no credit card required.
  • Save your favourite settings as templates. Store named presets (provider + tone + language + length) and load them in one click. Never re-configure the same settings twice.
  • Works inside the editor. The PurePen AI panel appears automatically in the Gutenberg sidebar and the Classic Editor meta box — no separate dashboard needed to generate content.
  • Your data stays private. Content is sent directly from your server to the AI provider you choose. Nothing passes through our servers.

Core Features (Free)

  • 8 AI providers — Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT-4o, Google Gemini, Mistral AI, Cohere, Groq, DeepSeek, and OpenRouter.
  • One-click “Generate Everything” — titles, full HTML article, tags, and meta excerpt in a single request.
  • Individual generators — generate only titles, only content, or only tags as needed.
  • 5 title options — choose from five AI-generated title variants and apply with one click.
  • Tag cloud — review AI-suggested tags and apply selected ones instantly.
  • Content templates / presets — save your provider, tone, language, and length settings as named templates and reload them any time. Up to 20 templates per site.
  • Guided onboarding wizard — step-by-step instructions to get a free API key from Groq, OpenRouter, or Google AI Studio, with a paste-and-save flow inside WordPress.
  • 8 writing tones — Professional, Casual, Persuasive, Informative, Humorous, Formal, Inspirational, Conversational.
  • 4 length targets — Short (~400 words), Medium (~850 words), Long (~1,600 words), Extra Long (~2,500 words).
  • 18 languages — generate content in English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Arabic, Hindi, and 11 more.
  • Multiple models per provider — select from the latest available models for each provider, including GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet, and Gemini 1.5 Pro.
  • Generation history — optional log of every generation, searchable and paginated.
  • Auto-save draft — automatically save generated content to the post on completion.
  • Provider visibility controls — show or hide individual providers in the editor to keep the UI clean.
  • Gutenberg and Classic Editor — full support for both editing experiences.
  • WooCommerce compatible — works alongside WooCommerce and most popular plugins without conflicts.

Supported AI Providers

  • Anthropic Claude — Claude Sonnet 4, Claude Opus 4, Claude Haiku (console.anthropic.com)
  • OpenAI GPT — GPT-4o, GPT-4 Turbo, GPT-3.5 Turbo (platform.openai.com)
  • Google Gemini — Gemini 1.5 Pro, Gemini 1.5 Flash (aistudio.google.com)
  • Mistral AI — Mistral Large, Mistral Medium, Mistral Small, Mixtral (console.mistral.ai)
  • Cohere — Command R+, Command R (dashboard.cohere.com)
  • Groq — Llama 3.3 70B, Llama 3.1, Mixtral — free tier, no credit card (console.groq.com)
  • DeepSeek — DeepSeek Chat V3, DeepSeek Reasoner R1 (platform.deepseek.com)
  • OpenRouter — Access 100+ models including free tiers via one API key (openrouter.ai)

Pro Features

Bulk Content Generation

Upload a CSV or TXT file of keywords and generate hundreds of articles automatically.

  • DB-backed queue with live status: pending → processing → done / failed
  • WP-Cron scheduler (5 min, 15 min, 30 min, hourly, daily intervals)
  • Keywords staggered to avoid API rate limits
  • Auto-publish or save as draft on completion
  • Yoast SEO and RankMath meta fields auto-filled per article
  • 3-attempt retry with exponential back-off
  • Pause, resume, and manual trigger controls

AI Image Engine

Generate and embed images for every article automatically.

  • 4 image providers: DALL-E 3/2 (OpenAI), Gemini Imagen 3 (Google), Flux Schnell/Dev/Pro/Ultra (Replicate), Stable Image Ultra/Core/SD 3/SDXL (Stability AI)
  • 3 image placement types: Featured image, Inline (inserted at H2 headings), Gallery (4 variants)
  • 12 style presets: Photorealistic, Cinematic, Digital Art, Watercolor, Oil Painting, Anime, 3D Render, Flat Design, Minimalist, Illustration, Pencil Sketch, Neon Cyberpunk
  • Test connection with live preview per provider
  • Quick generator — test image generation without opening a post
  • Auto aspect ratio conversion per provider

View the Pro version

Privacy Notice

PurePen AI sends your post topic, working title, and content excerpts to the external AI provider API you configure. Data travels directly from your WordPress server to that provider. Nothing is shared with the plugin authors.

Please review the privacy policy of the provider you use:

  • Anthropic: https://www.anthropic.com/privacy
  • OpenAI: https://openai.com/privacy
  • Google: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Mistral: https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/privacy-policy
  • Cohere: https://cohere.com/privacy
  • Groq: https://groq.com/privacy-policy/
  • DeepSeek: https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-privacy-policy.html
  • OpenRouter: https://openrouter.ai/privacy
sections.installation:
From the WordPress admin panel (recommended)

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New and search for “PurePen AI”.
  2. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  3. You will be redirected to the PurePen AI dashboard automatically.
  4. Use the 5 free generations immediately — no API key needed to get started.
  5. When ready for unlimited use, go to PurePen AI > AI Providers or follow the in-dashboard wizard to add a free API key.

Manual installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin and upload the zip.
  3. Activate and follow the steps above.

Starting to generate content

  1. Open any post or page in the editor.
  2. Find the PurePen AI panel in the Gutenberg sidebar (or below the editor in Classic Editor).
  3. Enter your topic, choose a tone and language, and click Generate Everything.
sections.faq:
Is PurePen AI free?

Yes. The core plugin is 100% free. Five free AI generations are included on activation with no API key required. For unlimited use, add a free API key from Groq or OpenRouter — both offer generous free tiers with no credit card.

Do I need to pay for an API key?

Not necessarily. Groq and OpenRouter both offer free API access. The in-plugin wizard walks you through getting one in about 2 minutes. Paid plans are available from all providers if you need higher volume or specific models.

How do I get started without an API key?

Simply install and activate the plugin. Five free generations are credited automatically. Click Generate Your First Post Now on the dashboard to try it immediately.

What are Content Templates?

Templates let you save a combination of AI provider, writing tone, language, and content length under a custom name. You can then load any template with one click from the editor instead of reconfiguring those settings every time. Up to 20 templates can be saved per site.

Does it work with Gutenberg and the Classic Editor?

Yes. PurePen AI supports both editors. The generation panel appears in the Gutenberg sidebar and as a meta box below the Classic Editor.

Will it slow down my website?

No. PurePen AI loads its scripts only on post/page editor screens and plugin admin pages. It has no impact on your site’s frontend performance.

Is it compatible with Yoast SEO and RankMath?

Yes. The SEO generator fills Yoast SEO and RankMath meta title, description, and focus keyword fields automatically when those plugins are active.

Is it compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes. PurePen AI works alongside WooCommerce and most popular plugins without conflicts.

Can I use my own API key?

Yes. Go to PurePen AI > AI Providers, enter your API key for any supported provider, and all content generation will use your own account and quota.

How many languages are supported?

18 languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Russian, Japanese, Chinese, Arabic, Hindi, Turkish, Polish, Korean, and more.

Where can I get support?

Post in the WordPress.org support forum or email support@solverwp.com. We respond within 48 hours.

Can I translate the plugin?

Yes. PurePen AI is fully translation-ready. Contribute translations at translate.wordpress.org.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • New: Content Templates — save named presets (provider, tone, language, length) and load them in one click from the editor. Up to 20 templates per site.
  • New: Guided API key onboarding wizard — replaces the trial-exhausted dead end with a 3-step in-dashboard wizard for Groq, OpenRouter, and Google AI Studio.
  • New: Deactivation survey — optional one-question feedback form shown on plugin deactivation to help us improve.
  • Improvement: Trial exhausted state on the dashboard and in the editor now shows the onboarding wizard instead of a plain block message.
  • Bump: Tested up to WordPress 7.0.

1.1.7

  • Tested up to WordPress 6.9.
  • Minor UI improvements.

1.1.6

  • Free trial credits on activation.
  • Unlimited image generation added.
  • Dashboard and provider status cards improved.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Generate titles, full HTML content, tags, and meta excerpt.
  • Supports 8 AI providers: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini, Mistral, Cohere, Groq, DeepSeek, OpenRouter.
  • Works with Gutenberg and Classic Editor.
  • Generation history log.
  • Multi-language and multi-tone support.
  • Provider visibility toggle per provider.
